remarks: Welcome to in-town living in New Canaan. Steps away, with walkable access to; train, downtown New Canaan, restaurants, grocery stores, library and more. This 2 bedroom, 1 bath apartment is a one of a kind opportunity. Situated above a 3 car garage with a separate entrance and your own garage space offering ample storage. This apartment features an open floor plan with full size kitchen, plenty of closet space, an in-unit stackable washer and dryer, making this a wonderful place to come home to. Private balcony off the living area gives you a nice place to relax and enjoy some fresh air. Available OCTOBER 1st. Good credit a must. Heat, hot water and garbage included in the rent.
